description: This file defines the 'mp::connect' class and its nested classes, representing the multiplayer connection interface for the Wesnoth game, including user management, network communication, and UI components.

classes.name: connect
classes.description: Represents the multiplayer connection interface, managing user sides, network communication, and UI elements.

classes.name: connect::side
classes.description: Represents a player's side in the multiplayer game, including UI components and configuration.

classes.name: connect::connected_user
classes.description: Data structure for storing information about a connected user, including name, controller, and network connection.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Constructor initializing the multiplayer connection interface with display, config, game data, chat, game list, parameters, and default controller.

methods.name: get_state
methods.description: Returns the current game state containing all scenario information.

methods.name: start_game
methods.description: Updates game state, resolves factions, and sends start game message over the network.

methods.name: gamelist_updated
methods.description: Updates the game list UI, optionally silently.

methods.name: process_event
methods.description: Handles user input and UI events.

methods.name: process_network_data
methods.description: Processes incoming network data.

methods.name: process_network_error
methods.description: Handles network errors.

methods.name: accept_connections
methods.description: Determines if new network connections are accepted.

methods.name: process_network_connection
methods.description: Handles new network connection events.

methods.name: hide_children
methods.description: Hides or shows child UI elements.

methods.name: load_game
methods.description: Loads game configuration.

methods.name: lists_init
methods.description: Initializes side lists.

methods.name: update_level
methods.description: Updates internal level data based on sides.

methods.name: update_and_send_diff
methods.description: Sends game state differences to clients.

methods.name: sides_available
methods.description: Checks if there are available sides for the game.

methods.name: update_playerlist_state
methods.description: Updates UI elements based on player list state.

methods.name: find_player
methods.description: Finds a player by ID.

methods.name: find_player_side
methods.description: Finds the side associated with a player ID.

methods.name: update_user_combos
methods.description: Updates user selection combos.

methods.name: kick_player
methods.description: Removes a player from the game.
